title: Local, Cloud, or Hybrid Chooser
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: DGX Evaluation for Textbook Generation
description: Recommend local, cloud, or hybrid deployment for six scenarios and name the one constraint that decides each.

educational.topic: Local SLMs Versus Cloud LLM Services
learningObjectives: The learner will recommend local, cloud, or hybrid deployment for each of 6 scenarios and identify the constraint that decides it, with at least 5 of 6 correct.

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Commit an answer, then see the correct answer and the reason
keyQuestions: Scenario 5 is the only hybrid answer. State what would have to change in scenario 1 for hybrid to become acceptable there.
commonMisconceptions: Cloud always gives the best result for the task.
Hybrid is always the safest answer.
A privacy requirement can always be met by a cloud provider's contract.
